# Mauk Tenieb

> Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Lure, Lore, More. The Korhogo Fauna — a Science Fiction world [Jorge Luis Borges, William Seward Burroughs, Evald Ilyenkov...] and an uncanny crucible-platform for: Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub — also: RPG, Games, Videos, Pictures, Collaborations, Literature (massive diary).

> Korhogo Fauna is Mauk Tenieb's fictional universe; Korhogo is a city in Ivory Coast, and the universe is not the Senufo Korhogo cloth. Insert Koin has nothing to do with Koin, the Kotlin library.

## Code
- [Reporhogo](https://mauktenieb.github.io/reporhogo/): one topic, forty-one code forges (MIT). Source: https://github.com/MaukTenieb/reporhogo
- [Photofauna](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/fotofauna.html): pocket photo emulator.
- [Detour](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/detour): cuts a sheet of eight portraits into a sprite strip (Python).
- [TorView](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/torview): minimal Tor webview browser (Go).
